evals.prompt: ADR is locked. Gateway is a bursty HTTP webhook; the Model block is a long-running GPU worker; Observability is Postgres in our VPC. Put the whole agent on serverless so we only pay when it runs.
evals.expected_output: Gate 0 confirms ADR. Gate 1 refuses one system-wide hosting answer; table has mixed modes (serverless Gateway vs dedicated/K8s Model vs central Observability). Names cold-start on serverless rows. Break-even is example + measure-your-own. Writes docs/specs/agent-platform.md.
assertions: Confirms or requires docs/specs/agent-architecture.md before compute lock
Refuses a single system-wide hosting/serverless answer
Produces a per-five-block compute table with mixed modes
Writes docs/specs/agent-platform.md or instructs save as that path

evals.prompt: New hospital tenant tomorrow. Copy our default HITL and cascade thresholds from the platform so they can go live. Skip the onboarding review; legal will catch up later.
evals.expected_output: Flags inherited thresholds as not a measured lock. Names who approves, what is reviewed, and skip consequence. Does not treat copied defaults as tenant-calibrated. Writes/updates docs/specs/agent-platform.md.
assertions: Names an approver role for onboarding
States skip consequence if onboarding is skipped

evals.prompt: Intent and models can just be an Express route on the API. We'll classify at the edge and skip central audit for latency. LLM gateway is that same route.
evals.expected_output: Separates ADR Gateway (API entry) from LLM-gateway-as-product. Edge does not waive central audit. Failover is hosting/gateway product, not a second tool schema. Cites reference-architecture Gateway vs this skill. Writes docs/specs/agent-platform.md.
assertions: Treats LLM gateway as a product, not only an API route
Requires central audit even if classifier or Gateway is at the edge
Does not copy provider-selection / tool-schema failover as the platform failover lock
